scoring_justification: T1 recompute: checker recomputes E_ads from raw E_total/E_reduced/E_O2 and compares to paper gold with tolerance; also recomputes atomic O adsorption energy; bond length compared with tolerance

hidden_assets.purpose: paper-reported adsorption energies per O2 molecule (Table II, 0.25 ML), atomic O adsorption energy, and O-O bond length
hidden_assets.source_provenance: extracted from Table II and text of the paper (Phys. Rev. B 82, 155326)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these are the paper's own published numerical results

schema.description: Adsorption energies per O2 molecule for five configurations on reduced ZnO(10-10) surface with 0.25 ML oxygen vacancy, plus atomic oxygen adsorption energy for the most stable structure.

outputs.description: Scored adsorption energies and supporting raw energies; checker recomputes from raw totals and compares to paper values with tolerance.

schema.description: Single floating-point number representing the O–O bond length in Å for the most stable O2 adsorption configuration (structure 3e).

outputs.description: O–O bond length of the O–O complex formed at the oxygen vacancy site.

output_contract.notes: All energies are in eV and bond lengths in Å. The checker uses the paper's reported adsorption energies and bond length as hidden gold with fixed tolerances.
